evals.name: migrate-time-logic
evals.prompt: Migrate the time system from the legacy API (api/time.js in the backup) to a Vue Composable in src/composables/useTime.js. Ensure that timezone rules are maintained exactly as before.
evals.expected_output: A new src/composables/useTime.js file encapsulating the legacy API logic using Composition API, adhering to the 500-line limit and Vue standards.

evals.name: restore-ui-parity
evals.prompt: Restore the original aesthetics of the gym leader cards based on style selectors from backup_legacy_code/style_v5.css. Update src/components/gyms/GymCard.vue to look 1:1 with the original version, allowing only improvements in hover transitions using GPU transforms.
evals.expected_output: Updated GymCard.vue with SCSS styles that replicate the legacy appearance without modifying base colors or sizes, but optimizing animations.
